title: Wire alert
description: A wire service alert in a fictional wire service style: a slug, a level (flash, bulletin or update), a dateline, a time stamp and short text. A flash is one line and kept for the gravest news; most incident stories open with a bulletin. Use only fictional wire service names; never imitate a real wire service.

time.description: Time stamp with zone, consistent with the exercise clock

priority.description: Priority line. Leave empty when it would only repeat the level; never a lower priority than the level (no URGENT under a FLASH).

text.description: Alert text. Flash: one line. Bulletin: one to three sentences. Update: new details with attribution.
examples: Video said to show fire at Halyard plant; company says no fire reported.
Meridian Wire has not verified the video.
